resource_risks.description: The new action may start two CLI adapter subprocess sessions at once.
resource_risks.mitigation: Fan-out defaults to 2 sessions and rejects maxSessions above 3; it reuses create_cli_session, SessionStore, cancel_cli_adapter_session, and cleanup_finished_sessions_locked.

resource_risks.description: A plan may contain more tools than should be started in the first multi-process slice.
resource_risks.mitigation: Renderer passes only the first two tool names, Rust default is 2, and Rust hard cap is 3.

resource_risks.description: A fan-out lane could try to inspect local-only private folders or transient output folders.
resource_risks.mitigation: Fan-out prompt explicitly forbids _private and outputs access and keeps manager-owned merge boundaries.
